why: A = proposition_6_26 (universes 0): for a NONEMPTY convex set C of Fredholm operators between arbitrary Banach spaces, DetOn C is a vector bundle with exactly two orientations. B: for every chart point of a smooth x, Lin(f, x) is convex and contractible, DET(f, x) is a vector bundle and has Nat.card = 2 orientations, with no hypothesis making Lin(f, x) nonempty. A ⇒ B fails only on A's hypothesis hne : C.Nonempty, which B does not give: proved B ⇒ NonemptyLin (contractible spaces are nonempty) and A ⇒ (B ↔ NonemptyLin), where NonemptyLin says every Lin(f, x) at a smooth point is nonempty; the missing hypothesis is satisfiable (it follows from the project's Bd.HasScPlusSectionsThrough via linSet_nonempty, true with sc-smooth bump functions; A_to_Bsec proves B under it), but without sc⁺-sections through −f(x) it is not known and B may be false (an empty Lin(f, x) has one orientation and is not contractible). B ⇒ A fails genuinely: A covers every nonempty convex C, B only the affine sets Lin(f, x) = L₀ + {sc⁺-operators}; obtaining A would mean re-proving the contractible-base ⇒ two-orientations argument.
B_issue: B is stated without a nonemptiness hypothesis on Lin(f, x) (as the blind side flagged); B holds iff every Lin(f, x) at a smooth point is nonempty (given A), which the text takes for granted and the project derives only from HasScPlusSectionsThrough (bump functions).
overlap: n/a (neither direction proved); auxiliary A_to_Bsec and B_imp_nonemptyLin pass #rt_check (they use convex_linSet, linSet_nonempty, isFredholm_of_mem_linSet, Convex.contractibleSpace).
